test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) Some trousers are pants.

2) All pants are jeans.

3) All jeans are coats.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pants are coats.

II. At least some trousers are jeans

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

1) Some trousers are pants.

2) All pants are jeans.

3) All jeans are coats.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd973d88c876da18b9b9165c526a83d9a055f8681e1a472e6c85eea00fc4a838.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pants are coats. → **True** (It is given that all pants are jeans and all jeans are coat, it simply means that all pants are coats.)

II. At least some trousers are jeans → **True** (It is given that some trousers are pants and all pants are jeans so the part of jeans which is pants is also trousers.)

So, **both conclusion** follows.

Hence, the correct answer is*** 'Option 3'.***
